entities.summary: David Long Jr. is an American professional football cornerback. He played college football for the Michigan Wolverines and was selected by the Los Angeles Rams in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. As a junior he was an All-Big Ten Conference selection. He is known for his nickname as "the Hawk".
